infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 220 in the three story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 220 key (Dorm 220) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "220" on it.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- 1 needs to be found for the quest Chemical - Part 1
- This is a required location for the quest Chemical - Part 2

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- In a train car on the western side of the location

- In the back of the not destroyed yellow truck next to warehouse #7.

- On a wooden crate on the second floor of the warehouse directly next to the ZB-1011 bunker extraction.

- On a tool trolley in the small building between the northern fuel silos next to the ZB-1011 bunker extraction.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- ZB-014 key spawn location
- Jacket
- Sports bag
- Loose loot (Roubles)
